Food

What comes to the table

From the menu and from what guests write in their Google reviews.

Pasta

From carbonara and amatriciana to vongole and cacio e pepe. Guests describe the pasta as fresh and homemade.

Pizza

Thin, crispy crust and fresh toppings, the margherita most of all. One guest enjoys watching the pizza being made and baked.

Pasta alla Ruota

Pasta with pecorino, truffle sauce and pepper, finished at your table in a 32 month old Parmigiano Reggiano wheel.

Tiramisu

16 reviews mention the tiramisu. Guests call it "a real one" and remind others not to forget to try it.

How guests describe a visit

Taken from what guests write in their Google reviews.

Like being in Italy

Guests write that you feel like you are in a city in Italy, and 9 reviews call it a cosy place.

Book a table

Guests recommend booking ahead, and say booking was easy.

Outdoor seating

Besides the dining room there are tables outside, among plants by the red doors.

An osteria in the heart of Nicosia

Behind red wooden doors and green plants on Zinonos Sozou: patterned tiles, checked tablecloths and Italian cooking. Open for lunch and dinner, Monday to Saturday.

What guests say

Three of 493 Google reviews, 404 of them with five stars.

“Amazing restaurant, very cozy atmosphere, you feel like you’re in a city in Italy. The staff were very friendly and kind, and the food was absolutely amazing.”

Google review
“Great spot for authentic Italian food in the heart of Nicosia. The pizzas are thin and crispy, and the pasta tastes fresh and homemade.”
